name: Wilfred
description: Everyone else sees Wilfred as just a dog, but Ryan sees a crude and somewhat surly, yet irrepressibly brave and honest Australian bloke in a cheap dog suit. While leading him through a series of comedic and existential adventures, Wilfred the dog shows Ryan the man how to overcome his fears and joyfully embrace the unpredictability and insanity of the world around him.

videos.title: Happiness
videos.overview: Ryan forms a unique connection with his neighbor's dog after a failed suicide attempt.

videos.title: Trust
videos.overview: Wilfred is angry after Ryan tricks him into going to the veterinarian.

videos.title: Fear
videos.overview: Ryan gets his wallet back (that's the good news) when his malevolent, porn-addicted neighbor Spencer shows up. The bad news? Spencer's looking for answers about who broke into his house. He's also looking for blood.

videos.title: Acceptance
videos.overview: Ryan tries to reconcile with his sister, and Wilfred is in for a shock at doggy day care as a result.

videos.title: Respect
videos.overview: Wilfred reveals an extraordinary ability when Ryan takes him to a hospice to volunteer.

videos.title: Conscience
videos.overview: Wilfred persuades Ryan to help him get rid of Jenna’s boyfriend.

videos.title: Pride
videos.overview: Ryan must swallow his pride when Wilfred pursues a new love interest., and Ryan meets a new romantic interest himself

videos.title: Anger
videos.overview: Ryan has a guilt complex over the death of his childhood dog, and Wilfred, upon learning of it, goes to otherworldly lengths to help Ryan discover the truth about how the pooch passed on. Meanwhile, Kristen throws a party for her boss.

videos.title: Compassion
videos.overview: Ryan's resentment of his mother even grows when she moves in and becomes friends with Wilfred.

videos.title: Isolation
videos.overview: Wilfred tries to find Ryan a human friend.

videos.title: Doubt
videos.overview: Ryan meets someone who questions Ryan's friendship to Wilfred.

videos.title: Sacrifice
videos.overview: Just as Ryan finds happiness in his life, Wilfred begs him to sacrifice it for a larger purpose.

videos.title: Identity
videos.overview: A crisis arises when Ryan ignores Wilfred's advice.

videos.title: Progress
videos.overview: Ryan learns that life is much more challenging without Wilfred around.

videos.title: Letting Go
videos.overview: When Wilfred comes to the conclusion Ryan is the only beneficiary of their friendship, he denies Ryan any further help.

videos.title: Dignity
videos.overview: Ryan has to deal with new problems when Wilfred becomes popular.

videos.title: Guilt
videos.overview: Ryan is forced to intervene when Wilfred becomes embattled with an unlikely foe.

videos.title: Now
videos.overview: Unexpected problems arise for Ryan and Wilfred after a traumatic experience.

videos.title: Control
videos.overview: Wilfred muddles Ryan's plan to introduce Amanda to Jenna.

videos.title: Avoidance
videos.overview: A hairy situation puts Wilfred and Ryan's friendship in jeopardy.

videos.title: Truth
videos.overview: Wilfred's nemesis returns with an offer that rocks Ryan's world.

videos.title: Service
videos.overview: A spontaneous road trip proves disastrous for Wilfred and Ryan.

videos.title: Honesty
videos.overview: Ryan and Wilfred make an extraordinary effort to boost Jenna's career.

videos.title: Questions
videos.overview: Ryan attempts to discover the truth about Wilfred through self-examination.

videos.title: Resentment
videos.overview: Wilfred derails Jenna and Drew's wedding because of Ryan's jealousy.

videos.title: Secrets
videos.overview: In the second-season finale, existential questions are posed to Wilfred and Ryan.

videos.title: Uncertainty
videos.overview: Ryan and Wilfred search for Wilfred’s original owner.

videos.title: Comfort
videos.overview: Ryan befriends Wilfred’s enemy—the mailman.

videos.title: Suspicion
videos.overview: Ryan distrusts his sister's new love interest.

videos.title: Sincerity
videos.overview: Ryan takes Wilfred to a dog training class in the hopes of winning over a girl.

videos.title: Shame
videos.overview: Ryan finds a roommate with Wilfred's help.

videos.title: Delusion
videos.overview: Wilfred forces Ryan to collaborate on a birthday gift for Jenna.

videos.title: Intuition
videos.overview: Wilfred leads Ryan on a crime-fighting caper.

videos.title: Perspective
videos.overview: Ryan tries progressive psychotherapy to better understand a past trauma.

videos.title: Confrontation
videos.overview: Wilfred crashes Christmas and pits Ryan against his family.

videos.title: Distance
videos.overview: A struggle emerges between Ryan, Wilfred and an old friend.

videos.title: Stagnation
videos.overview: Wilfred pursues a forbidden love.

videos.title: Heroism
videos.overview: Ryan is put in danger as Wilfred pursues the path to valor.

videos.title: Regrets
videos.overview: Season 3 ends with Jenna forbidding Ryan from seeing Wilfred when he needs him most.

videos.title: Amends
videos.overview: When Ryan's reality is upended, he gets a second chance to make things right.

videos.title: Consequences
videos.overview: Disaster strikes when Ryan and Wilfred get an unwanted guest on their camping trip.

videos.title: Loyalty
videos.overview: Ryan and Wilfred take sides in Kristen's custody battle.

videos.title: Answers
videos.overview: Ryan subjects Wilfred to a scientific study with unsettling results.

videos.title: Forward
videos.overview: Ryan and Wilfred have drastically different accounts of the same disturbing incident.

videos.title: Patterns
videos.overview: While trying to uncover who his father was paying off, Ryan runs into Bruce, only to be a pawn in his next game.

videos.title: Responsibility
videos.overview: Ryan helps his mother adjust to her new life as Wilfred deals with a new nemesis.

videos.title: Courage
videos.overview: Wilfred convinces Ryan to withhold sensitive information from Jenna.

videos.title: Resistance
videos.overview: Ryan fears a future without Wilfred, as his battle with cancer becomes more severe. Drew returns from Wisconsin.

videos.title: Happiness
videos.overview: Ryan finally learns his truths about Wilfred and his life.
